statement: Intel's Data Center and AI segment revenue grew 59% year-over-year to $6.3 billion in Q2 2026, within total revenue of $16.1 billion, up 25% year-over-year.
why: Strong growth at a third data-center silicon vendor shows the spending wave is lifting more than the two leading GPU makers.

impact.mechanism: Broad-based data-center silicon growth confirms buyers are expanding total compute budgets rather than only reallocating within accelerators.

evidence.excerpt: Data Center and AI (DCAI) segment revenue grew 59% year-over-year to $6.3 billion.
Total revenue was $16.1 billion, up 25% year-over-year, the fastest revenue growth in more than fifteen years.

confidence.basis: Primary vendor earnings release filed as an 8-K.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 1 -> 2; sources: Intel Corporation (IR press release)
